text: N=64 seed 22 (m2 fixed, data_seed 0, d_model=64) ends at layer-1 force R2 0.8235 at 6000 steps, 0.8398 at 12000 and 0.804 at 24000, so the endpoint does not rise with horizon. Fixed-seed runs are deterministic, so this comes from the lr schedule. Do the 6000-, 12000- and 24000-step N=128 runs of the same seed show the same non-monotone endpoint pattern? If they do, horizon checks across runs of different length are unreliable for force, and cross-N comparisons should only be made at matched horizon.
